summary: Iteration 3 focus: /api/extract switched to Gemini 3 Flash vision as PRIMARY OCR with Tesseract as offline fallback, /api/quality-check has_text is handwriting-aware. All verified. Backend: 26/26 pytest (20 regression + 6 new AI vision tests). New tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_vision_ocr.py confirm: (a) English handwriting-style image (italic/oblique font) → engine=='ai', text contains ≥3 expected key words, no commentary preamble, (b) Bengali image → engine=='ai', Bengali script (U+0980–U+09FF) preserved in response, no translation gloss, (c) new history record created and visible via GET /api/history, (d) quality-check has_text=true for both English and Bengali handwriting images (no 'no_text' issue) while blank white image STILL flags 'no_text' (regression protected). Tesseract fallback verified manually: temporarily set EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to an invalid value, restarted backend, POST /api/extract on a printed-text JPG returned 200 with engine=='tesseract' and correct text 'Hello Tesseract Fallback' — env then restored to original key and backend restarted. Frontend web smoke: home renders 'LipiScan' + subtitle + history list + New Scan FAB (testID home-new-scan-fab). Bengali history entries from AI-extraction (আমার সোনার বাংলা / আমি তোমায় ভালোবাসি) render correctly, confirming end-to-end AI-vision preservation of Bengali. FAB navigates to /camera; /review with no session correctly redirects to /camera (useEffect guard). New loading copy 'Reading your handwriting with AI (Bengali + English)…' confirmed by code review at app/review.tsx:150. No JS runtime/bundling errors observed on web preview.
action_items: None blocking. Optional carried-over item: pin tesseract-ocr + tesseract-ocr-ben + tesseract-ocr-eng in the container image so the ensure_tesseract() self-heal is not the primary install path.
Optional: /api/extract does not size-guard the incoming file. A very large image could blow up base64 encoding to the vision model. Consider a max-bytes check with 413.
Optional carried-over: replace deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan handlers in backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:238–265 /api/extract correctly catches only ValueError (invalid image) as 400 and falls back to Tesseract on any other Exception from run_vision_ocr — good structure. run_vision_ocr uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with provider='gemini' model='gemini-3-flash-preview' as requested.

backend/server.py:200–217 run_vision_ocr returns empty string on the NO_TEXT_FOUND sentinel — this means the endpoint returns 200 with text='' and engine='ai' for a blank frame. Acceptable, but the frontend review.tsx correctly shows the 'No text was detected' hint via review-no-text-hint.

backend/server.py:125–138 _has_ink_marks uses adaptive threshold + morphological open, threshold band [0.004, 0.45]. Correctly rejects fully-white frames (mean ~0) AND fully-black frames (mean saturated). Bengali and English handwriting images both produced has_text=true in tests.
frontend/src/api.ts:1–11 nativeFilePart uses expo-file-system `File` for Expo SDK 57 WinterCG fetch — cannot be verified on web preview but code path is correct per the Expo SDK 57 change notes.
frontend/app/review.tsx:141–146 renders review-fallback-hint only when data.engine === 'tesseract' — copy is clear and offers AI Cleanup / retry as next steps.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ai_vision_ocr.py (new — 6 tests covering AI engine, Bengali preservation, history growth, handwriting-aware quality-check, blank regression)
/app/backend/tests/manual_fallback_check.py (new — one-shot script used to verify Tesseract fallback while EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was invalid; safe to keep as regression tool)

success_rate.frontend: web smoke only per instructions — home + navigation + review guard passed

seed_data_creation: Extract tests created ephemeral history records with recognisable text (quick brown fox, আমার সোনার বাংলা, Hello Tesseract Fallback). All 5 test records were cleaned up via DELETE /api/history/{id} after the run — verified via GET /api/history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://docx-capture.preview.emergentagent.com. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env is required for /api/extract (primary Gemini vision) and /api/cleanup (gpt-5.4). Tesseract binary must be present (tesseract-ocr + tesseract-ocr-ben + tesseract-ocr-eng) for the fallback path and for /api/quality-check quick-OCR probe. Bengali fonts installed for tests: fonts-noto-core, fonts-beng, fonts-beng-extra, fonts-lohit-beng-assamese (rendered via PIL.ImageFont.truetype /usr/share/fonts/truetype/lohit-bengali/Lohit-Bengali.ttf). To force a Tesseract-fallback test, temporarily set EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=sk-invalid... in backend/.env, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, run /app/backend/tests/manual_fallback_check.py, RESTORE the key, restart backend again. /review screen guards on session.photoUri (in-memory) so it will always redirect to /camera in headless browsers — camera capture / .docx picking can only be validated on a physical device.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. The user-reported 'garbled handwriting' bug has been resolved by switching to Gemini 3 Flash vision as the primary OCR: verified via test_english_handwriting_returns_ai_engine_with_readable_text (finds ≥3 key words from the rendered handwriting-style image) and test_bengali_stays_bengali_and_engine_ai (verifies Bengali Unicode block present in response, no English translation).
